title: Toolify3D
claim: Upload an STL, get a price. No human in the loop.
heroShotLabel: Hero: the quote screen with an uploaded mesh and its price
heroCaption: Customer upload screen showing parsed dimensions, volume, material selector, and price.
problem: Manual quoting via Messenger is slow and loses customers.
Uploaded STLs contain all needed data, but weren't being parsed.
built: 3 decoupled services: storefront, API, and admin dashboard.
Client-side binary STL parsing calculates volume via tetrahedron sums, plus bounding box for time estimates.
Admin dashboard with dynamic rate tables updates prices instantly without redeploys.
Dual parsing (client-side for instant quote, server-side for validation) handles 200k+ triangle meshes in under a second.

images.shotLabel: Upload → quote, price and time visible
images.caption: Instant quote screen with derived volume and time.
Order states: quoted, accepted, printing, collected.
No-deploy rate tables for materials and margins.

change: Move parsing entirely server-side behind a job queue for better trust.
Add support material estimation based on overhang angles.

title: MediGo
heroShotLabel: Hero: live request being matched on the map
heroCaption: Live patient request showing symptoms, location pin, and notified doctors.
problem: Traditional directories show who exists, not who is available nearby.
Doctor availability must be a live property, not static data.
built: Socket.io state machine manages consultation requests (open, offered, accepted, withdrawn, closed).
Server fans out requests to on-call doctors in a radius. First accept wins; radius auto-expands if ignored.
Matching uses straight-line haversine distance via OpenStreetMap coordinates.

images.shotLabel: Patient request screen, waiting for accept
images.caption: Patient view of offered doctors and search radius.

images.shotLabel: Doctor's incoming offer with accept action
images.caption: Doctor view showing distance and request age.

change: Persist live request state in the database instead of server memory.
Use district-based socket rooms instead of global fan-out filtering.

title: NBA Cyber-Cell
claim: Harassment reports, triaged and tracked. National rollout.
heroCaption: Triage queue ordering reports by severity, assignee, and state.
problem: Harassment reports were unstructured, lacking secure records for handovers or updates.
Reporters needed a system safe for shared devices.
built: Accountless submission form issuing reference codes for reporters to check status securely.
Append-only triage queue acts as the immutable handover document for case escalation.
Strict data scoping: no mandatory identity, signed links for evidence, and owner-only access to contact details.
Built with an insider-threat model to prevent careless admin data leaks.

images.caption: Accountless form issuing a reference code.

images.shotLabel: Case detail with append-only action log
images.caption: Immutable action log for secure escalation.

change: Chain log entries to previous hashes to make database tampering detectable.
Add local draft saving for users on unstable network connections.

title: Sportnest
claim: Booking platform with JWTs verified against a remote JWKS endpoint.
heroShotLabel: Hero: booking flow with a slot selected
heroCaption: Booking grid showing daily venue slots with held and taken status.
problem: Shared JWT secrets mean a compromised app server can mint valid tokens.
Financial and schedule data require stronger auth architecture.
built: Decoupled signing and verification. The API only verifies tokens; the auth service isolates the private key.
Remote JWKS verification via `jose` with cached TTL. Key rotation requires no redeploys.
Resource-level authorization checking token subjects against record owners, avoiding over-granted roles.

images.caption: Slot availability resolved per venue and day.
Bookings strictly scoped by token subject.

change: Implement short-lived access tokens with rotating refresh tokens for better theft detection.
Add a push channel to invalidate the key cache for emergency rotations.
